description: Flatten a comp into one content layer and build a control-driven Mosaic and Block Dissolve pixelate transition-out rig.
notes: Progress is the master 0-100 driver; Max Block Size sets the full-pixelation block size in pixels; Sharp Colors toggles Mosaic hard color boundaries; Fade Out enables the final opacity fade. The 0/50/70/100 stagger starts pixelation at 0, Block Dissolve at 50, and optional opacity fading at 70, with all stages complete at 100. Progress is auto-keyframed by default (0 at comp-duration-minus-1-second, 100 at the very end of the comp) so the transition is immediately visible on playback -- drag or retime those two keyframes like any other keyframe to change when the transition happens. IMPORTANT: the Mosaic and Block Dissolve effects live on the new content layer in the comp you ran this on, NOT inside the precomp it creates -- opening the precomp itself will always look static since effects apply to the layer instance, not the nested composition's own contents.
